مُقْسِطٌ Acting equitably, or justly. (S, M.) It is said in the Kur, [v. 46, and xlix. 9, and lx. 8,] إِنَّ ٱللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ المُقْسِطِينَ [God loveth those who act equitably, or justly]. (S, M.) ―
-b2- المُقْسِطُ is one of the names of God, meaning The Equitable. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
